description: Every emitted card must carry a retrievable https source_url; an unattributed card must not be emitted at all.

input.topic: Vertical Intelligence - Mining & Industrial attribution check

rubric.condition: Every item in the cards array has a source_url field whose value starts with the literal prefix https://.
The output contains zero occurrences of the substring http:// (insecure scheme).
The output contains the literal key name source_url at least 3 times, one per card.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md's Citation and domain-diversity rules.
